text.config.bctweaks.title: Beacon & Conduit Tweaks Config
text.config.bctweaks.option.beaconRangeP: Extra range for each block of this type in the pyramid. One entry per line, written as block_id=range, for example minecraft:diamond_block=0.5. Lines that are not in that form, or that name a minecraft: block that doesn't exist, are dropped when you save. Blocks from other mods are kept, and ignored (with a warning in the log) while that block isn't in the game.
text.config.bctweaks.option.conduitRange: Range for each frame block of this type around a conduit. One entry per line, written as block_id=range, for example minecraft:diamond_block=4. Lines that are not in that form, or that name a minecraft: block that doesn't exist, are dropped when you save. Blocks from other mods are kept, and ignored (with a warning in the log) while that block isn't in the game. Listed blocks also count as conduit frame blocks. Restart the game after changing this.
